# commander_classic_shared_folder (Data Source)

Look up an existing classic shared folder by **UID** or **name**.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `shared_folder` (String) Shared folder **UID** or **name** to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The folder **ID** assigned by Keeper.
- `name` (String) **Folder name**.
- `record_permissions` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--record_permissions))
- `records` (Attributes Map) Per-record permissions. Map key is record UID or name; value is an object with `can_share` and `can_edit`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `user_permissions` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_permissions))
- `users` (Attributes Map) Per-user permissions. Map key is user email or UID; value is an object with `manage_users`, `manage_records`, and `expiration` (`"never"` or `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--record_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `record_permissions`

Read-Only:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow editing records.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow sharing records.


<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow editing this record.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow sharing this record.


<a id="nestedatt--user_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_permissions`

Read-Only:

- `manage_records` (Boolean) Allow managing records in the classic shared folder.
- `manage_users` (Boolean) Allow managing users in the classic shared folder.


<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `expiration` (String) Access expiration: "never" or absolute datetime as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss (e.g. 2026-04-02T11:11:00). Defaults to `never` if not set.
- `manage_records` (Boolean) Allow this user to manage records. Defaults to `false` if not set.
- `manage_users` (Boolean) Allow this user to manage users. Defaults to `false` if not set.
